headline: Colts waive Daniel Jones, turn to Anthony Richardson at QB

top.headline: Colts waive Daniel Jones, turn to Anthony Richardson at QB
top.summary: Shane Steichen announced Friday that Anthony Richardson Sr. will start and the Colts will release Daniel Jones. Jones went 12 of 27 for 144 yards with an interception in Thursday's 26-3 loss to Houston and leads the league with 13 interceptions. A team that claims him would owe just over $2 million this season and $38 million in non-guaranteed money in 2027, per NFL Network.

top.headline: Harden scores 51, passes Kobe for third-most 50-point games
top.summary: James Harden had 51 points on 15-of-26 shooting, 7-of-11 from three and 14-of-14 at the line as Cleveland beat Indiana 128-119 in an NBA Cup game. It was his 26th 50-point game, behind only Wilt Chamberlain (118) and Michael Jordan (31). At 37, he is the fourth-oldest player to score 50 or more.

top.headline: Dodgers acquire Royce Lewis from Twins
top.summary: Minnesota traded infielder Royce Lewis, the No. 1 overall pick in 2017, to the Dodgers for right-hander Bobby Miller and minor league catcher Francisco Espinoza. Lewis hit .227 with 15 homers and 57 RBIs in 2026. The deal came on the day of Friday's non-tender deadline.

stories.headline: Baker Mayfield questionable for Bucs at Lions
stories.summary: Mayfield (foot, right thumb) is officially questionable for Sunday in Detroit after limited practices Thursday and Friday. Todd Bowles said he is "trending in the right direction." If he can't go, undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels would start for 3-6 Tampa Bay against the 7-2 Lions.

stories.headline: Kyler Murray out; Kirk Cousins expected to start in Mexico City
stories.summary: Minnesota ruled out Murray (hamstring) and WR Jordan Addison (thumb) for Sunday night's game against the 49ers in Mexico City. Cousins, who rejoined the Vikings in a trade with the Raiders, is expected to start, with Carson Wentz as the backup.

stories.headline: Broncos give CB Riley Moss four-year, $67M extension
stories.summary: Denver and Moss agreed to a four-year extension worth $67 million, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. It locks up a starting corner through 2030.

stories.headline: Week 11 injury reports: Walker out, Evans questionable
stories.summary: Kansas City ruled out RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) and G Trey Smith (concussion) against Arizona. San Francisco listed WR Mike Evans (Achilles) and QB Mac Jones (illness) as questionable. Dallas ruled out TE Jake Ferguson and CB DaRon Bland.

It was his 26th 50-point game, behind only Wilt Chamberlain (118) and Michael Jordan (31). At 37, he is the fourth-oldest player to score 50 or more.

stories.headline: Short-handed Thunder rally past Pelicans behind SGA's 40
stories.summary: Oklahoma City trailed by as many as 16 in the third quarter and won 126-120. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 40, and his and-one with 34.8 seconds left put OKC up eight. The Pelicans fell to 5-12 and 0-3 in Cup play.

stories.headline: Raptors end six-game skid with 105-102 win at Detroit
stories.summary: Scottie Barnes scored 29 and hit the go-ahead drive after a late Cade Cunningham three. Allen Graves had 20 points and 10 rebounds in his first career start. Toronto won without RJ Barrett, Collin Murray-Boyles and Kawhi Leonard.

stories.headline: Franz Wagner's late jumper keeps Magic perfect in Cup play
stories.summary: Wagner had 35 points and 7 assists and hit the go-ahead jumper in Orlando's 113-111 win at Brooklyn, his first game against brother Moe as an opponent. The Magic are 3-0 in East Group A.

stories.headline: Bucks, 1-15, take 12-game skid to Philadelphia
stories.summary: Milwaukee was idle Friday and visits the 13-3 Sixers on Saturday. Myles Turner and Kyle Kuzma are out with shoulder injuries. Philadelphia has won four straight.

stories.headline: Rangers acquire Max Sasson from Canucks
stories.summary: Vancouver traded forward Max Sasson to the Rangers on Friday for a 2029 fourth-round pick. Sasson, 26, has five goals and three assists in 24 games. He is in the first year of a two-year, $2 million contract.

stories.headline: Malkin to miss Penguins game Saturday
stories.summary: Evgeni Malkin is day to day with an upper-body injury and will sit against Nashville, with an update due Tuesday. Pittsburgh also put Nicholas Robertson on injured reserve.

stories.headline: Ovechkin sets Capitals assists record in fourth straight loss
stories.summary: Alex Ovechkin's 763rd assist broke Nicklas Backstrom's franchise record in Thursday's 6-3 home loss to Buffalo. Washington has lost four straight and allowed at least five goals in each. The Capitals are 10-10-0.

stories.headline: Oilers visit Hurricanes in division leaders' matchup
stories.summary: Edmonton (17-4-3), first in the Pacific, plays at Metropolitan-leading Carolina at 1 p.m. ET Saturday. Both lost Thursday. Ryan Nugent-Hopkins will miss his fourth straight game.

stories.headline: Tigers, Troy Melton agree to six-year extension
stories.summary: Detroit agreed to a six-year, $46.5 million extension with right-hander Troy Melton that includes a 2033 club option, according to a source. Melton moved into the rotation last season and posted a 2.76 ERA over 20 starts.

stories.headline: Ober, Gil, Gorman among players non-tendered
stories.summary: Friday's non-tender deadline sent 44 players into free agency, according to theScore's tracker. Among them were Bailey Ober, Luis Gil, Nolan Gorman, David Fry and Davis Schneider.
